description: This file is a header (.h) file for the PduR_LinIf module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software project. It declares interface functions related to LIN interface handling within the PduR (PDU Router) module, including receive indication, transmission confirmation, and trigger transmit functions. The file includes licensing and project information, include guards, and conditional compilation directives.

methods.name: PduR_LinIfRxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception of a PDU from the LIN interface, passing the PDU ID and data to the PDU Router.

methods.name: PduR_LinIfTxConfirmation
methods.description: Confirms the successful transmission of a PDU via LIN interface to the PDU Router.

methods.name: PduR_LinIfTriggerTransmit
methods.description: Requests transmission of a PDU through LIN interface, providing PDU ID and buffer for the data.
